name: linear-modal-standalone
title: Linear Modal Standalone
blurb: Draggable card carousel that expands to a centered modal on click.
description: A complete, self-contained dialog system with a horizontal carousel of cards that animates to a full modal on activation. Uses layout animations (Framer Motion) to morph cards into centered dialogs. Includes backdrop fade, image zoom, and…
use_when: You need a gallery experience where cards animate into modals — ready to drop in with no external setup.
avoid_when: Touch devices without horizontal scroll intent — dragging may trigger unwanted touches.
a11y: Keyboard navigable: Tab focus on cards, Enter/Space opens, Escape closes. ARIA labels on buttons and dialog. Focus trap on backdrop click to close.
